title: A New Stage for Young Musicians
transcript: The town hall will host a free monthly concert for young musicians starting in April. Performers between fourteen and nineteen can apply by sending a short recording to the organisers. Each concert will include four groups, and every group will have fifteen minutes on stage. A local music teacher will be available afterwards to give advice. The council plans to record the concerts so that performers can share their work with friends who cannot attend.

options: By attending a lesson at the town hall.
By writing a song for the council.
By buying a ticket in advance.
questions.explanation: 申请者要向组织者发送一小段录音。

questions.prompt: Why does the council plan to record the concerts?
options: To let performers share them with absent friends.
To select a winner at the end of the year.
To help the town hall sell tickets.
To show future teachers how to run concerts.
questions.answer: To let performers share them with absent friends.
questions.explanation: 录下演出可供无法到场的朋友观看或收听。
